answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because comet only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, mirror is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any summit approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
